experience.title: Technical journey
experience.description: Five years of building scalable, AI-powered products for emerging markets — each role shaped my approach to systems and product engineering.

aiAdvokat.description: Founded and built AI Advokat alongside a full-time role — a practice management SaaS for Ex-YU lawyers with case management, tracking, billing and document automation. Architected a Java/Spring Boot backend and React frontend with RAG-powered AI, automated workflows and web scraping for Balkan legal data.

tenfore.description: Designing high-performance microservices in Spring Boot, building event-driven workflows on Kafka and Axon, and shipping React features that cut user onboarding time by 40%.

mod24.description: Delivered multi-platform applications with Vue.js, React and Next.js. Architected Laravel services with gRPC and RabbitMQ. Optimized Elasticsearch queries from 2s down to under 500ms.

infogram.description: Applied DDD and CQRS patterns to ship maintainable apps. Delivered cross-platform with React and React Native. Led migration of legacy monoliths to modular architectures.

projects.title: Projects in production
projects.description: A curated list of products and systems I've designed, built and shipped — across legal-tech, fintech, e-commerce, cultural archives and streaming.
projects.internalNote: Internal & client work shipped under NDA. Names, screenshots and links are intentionally redacted — context and impact available on request.

aiAdvokat.title: AI Advokat
aiAdvokat.description: AI-powered practice management SaaS for lawyers in Serbia & Ex-YU. Case management, RAG-based document analysis, billing, automated court-portal scraping. Live since Feb 2026.

wuonline.title: WU Online
wuonline.description: Regulated fintech platform for Western Union money transfers in Serbia, operated by Tenfore. KYC + video identification, MTCN tracking, multi-method card payments and high-throughput, audited transaction flows.

mod24.title: MOD24
mod24.description: US-wide marketplace where customers compare and hire vetted moving companies. Built vendor dashboards, real-time messaging, complex pricing and rating, and Elasticsearch-powered search (latency cut from 2s to <500ms).

dynamicLife.title: Dynamic Life
dynamicLife.description: Mobile app for a savings + life-insurance program in partnership with Generali Serbia. Built the React Native client: barcode and QR scanning of receipts at partner retailers, round-up payments, transaction history, partner tracking and gamified engagement.

sexsurance.title: SexSurance Platform
sexsurance.description: End-to-end mobile + backoffice platform for time-stamped video consent records. React Native / Expo client with face-detected camera capture, Twilio OTP phone verification, geolocation tagging and chunked uploads to S3-compatible storage. Laravel backoffice with Doctrine ORM, Redis caching, search and pagination over records, plus full Docker / Traefik infrastructure across dev / stage / prod.

rexair.title: Rexair B2B Commerce
rexair.description: B2B e-commerce platform for Rexair LLC (Rainbow Cleaning System, USA) — supports their global distributor network with multi-branch / per-store catalogs, branch-scoped pricing and inventory, dealer ordering flows and Redis-backed caching for high-traffic catalog reads.

trigos.title: Trigos
trigos.description: B2B + B2C e-commerce platform for construction materials in Serbia (paints, insulation, drywall, adhesives). Brand-level filtering, dual wholesale/retail flows and multi-method checkout.

putsvile.title: Put Svile
putsvile.description: E-commerce store for children's books, graphic novels and educational toys. Catalog, wishlist, threshold-based free delivery and full payment-gateway integration.

vaju.title: Visual Archive of Yugoslavia
vaju.description: Digital archive for the Museum of Yugoslavia — 12,000+ photographs with photographer and personality biographies. Full-text + faceted search across collections, multilingual UI (sr-cyr / sr-lat / en). Backed by the Swiss National Science Foundation.

mojoff.title: MojOFF
mojoff.description: First domestic SVOD streaming platform in Serbia — exclusive premieres of regional and world cinema, three subscription tiers, weekly releases and ~50 new titles per month. Project archived.
